description: Ocean Infinity 2018 MH370 seabed search (Seabed Constructor, Hugin AUVs), reconstructed from public maps.
ring_format: closed rings [[lon, lat], ...], first == last; holes listed separately
reference_arc: sea-level 7th arc from mh370.geo (BTO 18,400 us at 00:19:29.416); d>0 = SE (outside) of arc

polygons.name: OI2018_Site1
polygons.source: Government of Malaysia, "MH370 Operational Search Update" #11 (2018-04-10), page 2 Diagram 2 (Site 1 Areas 01-03 completed); archived PDF via web.archive.org of http://mh370.gov.my/en/mh370-underwater-search-2018?download=... (file weekly_updates/OSU11_2018-04-10.pdf, figure figures_extracted/OSU11_p2_x31_451x465.png)
polygons.notes: Site 1 = ATSB/FPR priority area (planned 25,000 km2 primary + supplementary = 33,012 km2) plus the "additional areas along the Northern Leg of Site 1/Area 1 and the Southern Leg of Site 1/Area 1". Searched 22 Jan - ~5 Apr 2018 (OSU#11: Site 1 complete, 38,214 km2). U-shaped: the concavity between the two legs (~33-35.5S) is the strip already searched by the ATSB/GO Phoenix and was NOT part of Site 1. Georef: 8 graticule crosses (2 deg), UTM 46S affine, rms 0.22 km; outline = non-background pixels (includes outline line and grey extra-coverage halo), so boundary is biased ~0.5-1 km outward; area +3% vs reported. Validated against OSU#10 map (median boundary diff 0.7 km, p90 1.8 km) and against the OI-supplied outline published by V. Iannello (11 Feb 2023) near 34.2S: edges agree to 1-3 km.

polygons.name: OI2018_Site2
polygons.source: Government of Malaysia, "MH370 Operational Search Update" #17 (2018-05-22), page 2, Site 2 progress map (Areas 1-3 incl. Broken Ridge, P04S02_v18); archived PDF via web.archive.org of http://mh370.gov.my/en/mh370-underwater-search-2018?download=... (file weekly_updates/OSU17_2018-05-22.pdf, figure figures_extracted/OSU17_p2_x32_610x442.png)
polygons.notes: Searched ~5-15 Apr 2018 (OSU#11-#12). Reported area derived as 53,000 (Sites 1+2, OSU#12) - 38,214 (Site 1). Georef: 10 crosses at 0.5 deg, UTM 46S affine, rms 0.12 km. Width ~108 km (-45..+63 km from the sea-level arc).

polygons.name: OI2018_Site3
polygons.source: Government of Malaysia, "MH370 Operational Search Update" #17 (2018-05-22), page 2, Site 3 progress map (P04S03_v16, complete); archived PDF via web.archive.org of http://mh370.gov.my/en/mh370-underwater-search-2018?download=... (file weekly_updates/OSU17_2018-05-22.pdf, figure figures_extracted/OSU17_p2_x37_538x564.png)
polygons.notes: Searched ~15 Apr - ~14 May 2018 (port call 28 Apr - 7 May). Reported area derived as 88,200 (Sites 1-3, OSU#17) - 53,000. Georef: 9 crosses at 1 deg (lat labels cropped off the figure; latitudes assigned from consistency with the overview map and with the Site-4 box, whose SW corners match Site 3 NE corners within 1 km), UTM 47S affine, rms 0.22 km. NW edge may include up to ~2 km of pale shallow seabed between 28.3S and 29.2S.

polygons.name: OI2018_Site4_to_27May
polygons.source: Government of Malaysia, "MH370 Operational Search Update" #18 (2018-05-29), page 3 Diagram 3 (Site 4 coverage as of 27 May 2018); archived PDF via web.archive.org of http://mh370.gov.my/en/mh370-underwater-search-2018?download=... (file weekly_updates/OSU18_2018-05-29.pdf, figure figures_extracted/OSU18_p3_x40_499x521.png)
polygons.notes: Searched 14-27 May 2018. Georef: 4 crosses at 1 deg, UTM 47S affine, rms 0.07 km (only 4 control points).

polygons.name: OI2018_Site4_box
polygons.source: Government of Malaysia, "MH370 Operational Search Update" #18 (2018-05-29), page 3 Diagram 3, Site 4 survey box outline (P04S04_v7); archived PDF via web.archive.org of http://mh370.gov.my/en/mh370-underwater-search-2018?download=... (file weekly_updates/OSU18_2018-05-29.pdf, figure figures_extracted/OSU18_p3_x40_499x521.png)
polygons.notes: Planned Site 4 survey box, ~81 km wide (-38..+44 km from the sea-level arc, i.e. ~+/-22 NM), 28.7S-26.3S. Its NE part (~26.3-26.9S) was not yet covered on 27 May; completion ~27-30 May is INFERRED from the AIS track (vessel reached 26.30S on 28 May, 26.13S on 29 May) and community daily reports, not from an official map.

polygons.name: OI2018_North_extension_inferred
polygons.source: Inferred: no official map. Evidence: Seabed Constructor AIS track (community KMZ, LabratSR Dropbox, data/derived/oi2018_search/seabed_constructor_track_2018.csv) reaching 25.80S (31 May), 25.10S (4 Jun), 24.76S (6 Jun); V. Iannello 8 Jun 2018 "searched as far north as 25S and at a width of at least +/-22 NM"; R. Godfrey daily comments on radiantphysics.com (31 May - 7 Jun 2018); AirlineRatings 31 May 2018 (OI spokesman: vessel to remain a few days to sweep the area of the 2014 Chinese ping near 25S 101E).
polygons.notes: ~30 May - 7 Jun 2018, after the official end of the search (29 May). Corridor continued with the Site-4 cross-arc limits (-36.8 to +44.7 km from the sea-level arc) up to arc-latitude 25.0S. The northern limit is uncertain by roughly -0.25/+0.3 deg (vessel reached 24.76S; last AUVs were recovered early). Coverage quality likely lower: Richard Cole (quoted by AirlineRatings 31 May 2018) "the gaps between AUV tracks have been opened out again"; Godfrey 4 Jun 2018: AUV54 recovered early, AUV55 swath 5.2 km instead of 7.4 km. Treat with reduced POD and as a sensitivity case.

polygons.name: OI2018_best_estimate_total
polygons.source: Union of OI2018_Site1, Site2, Site3, Site4_to_27May, Site4_box and North_extension_inferred
polygons.notes: Best estimate of all seabed searched by OI in 2018 (22 Jan - 7 Jun 2018). Boundary error ~1-2 km except the northern end (inferred, ~25 km along-arc). Official total ">112,000 km2" (OI/Malaysia, 29 May 2018) refers to coverage up to ~29 May; community estimates of the final total are ~115,000-120,000 km2.

polygons.name: OI2018_documented_to_27May
polygons.source: Union of OI2018_Site1, Site2, Site3, Site4_to_27May (official maps only)
polygons.notes: Conservative: only coverage shown on official maps (OSU#18 reports 88,200 + 18,000 = 106,200 km2 as of 27 May 2018).
